name: preserves the current turn when backend refresh fails
covers: Fake state whose second refresh rejects; no project graph, no source cache.

name: clears caches before awaiting project release and rejects at the backend boundary
covers: Fake graph with one held and one later release. Asserts refill during the wait, release unsettled while held, backend rejection, later release never called.

name: shares caches within one turn and clears them for the next turn
covers: Real backend; reference search runs once per turn.

name: clears every handle at turn and release boundaries
covers: Two handles; beginTurn, then release twice; factories run 3 times each.

name: does not let an old promise settlement replace a new turn entry
covers: Old promise settles after beginTurn; cache still returns the new promise.
